style: Create a premium educational 3D CARTOON infographic illustration for adult agricultural vocational students. Clearly stylized, not a photograph: sculpted rounded forms, simplified larger soil clumps and leaves, clean silhouettes, slightly exaggerated friendly proportions. Retain realistic physically based materials: tactile earth, brushed stainless steel, matte plastic, soft woven fabric. Polished animated-feature quality with studio global illumination, soft contact shadows and ambient occlusion. Warm off-white background, natural sage/grass greens, rich brown soil, warm cream. One coherent staged scene, generous spacing, 3D depth immediately obvious at mobile size. No flat vector illustration, no flat icons, no photographic clutter, no faces, no branding. NO TEXT, letters, labels, numbers or arrows anywhere; all precise labels will be added separately in code. Keep all objects fully inside the image with margin. Use the attached accepted art only as reference for rounded shapes, materials, lighting and style, not for its objects.

assets.subject: Reading-only oblique 3D miniature of ONE agricultural field whose terrain naturally varies: left lower shallow basin has visibly damp surface and a small amount of standing water, right area rises into a higher well-drained planted slope. Coherent natural terrain connects both, NOT arbitrary equal strips. A small isolated bare patch at the far upper edge remains spatially separate from both general sampling areas; do not imply a diagnosed cause. Show varied conditions with height and water, not colour alone. Fine natural planted rows, rounded earth, no tools, samples, route, point dots, text or arrows. Entire diorama visible with room for later zone overlays. Camera distinct from the video field scenes.

Reading worksheet base: almost overhead orthographic 3D plan of ONE rectangular reasonably uniform training plot, softly bevelled raised earth edges. Keep a large clean flat planted inner area covering the central 65 percent for a later ten-point editable route. A tiny gate and worn entry at bottom-left OUTSIDE this central area, small hoof-disturbed gathering corner at far bottom-left, a narrow contrasting old fertilizer-band strip along the far left edge, and a small irregular bare-problem patch at the far top-right edge; these are supplied scenario features, not diagnoses. Very shallow perspective so map overlays can be placed accurately. NO path, no W line, no arrows, no sample dots, no pegs, no text/numbers/letters/icons, no animals or humans. All points and precise route will be separate overlays; do not bake a misleading count into the art.

Reading-only coherent 3D comparison arrangement: at LEFT a small cultivated-soil cutaway with short seedlings and visible roots, a clearly visible selected shallow surface-layer band and a narrow clean vertical core inside that band. The full roots may continue below the selected band; do not equate sample depth with full crop rooting depth. At RIGHT three separated blank cream rounded 3D cards on low plinths for later comparison of different source example counts. Keep every card blank, no count marks or dots. Provide empty margins next to the soil layer for exact editable depth brackets; empty space above for later field-area units. NO writing, dimensions, numbers, arrows, tick marks, ruler, randomization claims or fertilizer objects. Not to scale; final depth/example labels are separate.
